name: SAP S/4HANA
certifications: SAP Certified Associate - SAP Activate Project Manager (C_ACT)
SAP Certified Associate - Implementation Consultant - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Financial Accounting
SAP Certified Associate - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Implementation with SAP Activate

beginner.summary: For new consultants, key users and IT staff with no SAP experience. Covers ERP concepts, navigation in Fiori and SAP GUI, the enterprise structure, master data and the main end-to-end processes (procure to pay, order to cash, plan to produce, record to report), reporting and the basics of S/4HANA projects.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of how a company buys, sells, produces and accounts
Comfortable with business software and spreadsheets
Access to an SAP S/4HANA training system
outcomes: Navigate S/4HANA in Fiori and SAP GUI
Explain the enterprise structure and key master data
Run the main end-to-end business processes in a training system
Describe how S/4HANA projects are run with SAP Activate

days.topic: ERP and SAP S/4HANA Overview
subtopics: What changed in S/4HANA: the HANA database and simplified data model
Deployment options: on-premise, Private Cloud, Public Cloud and RISE with SAP
SAP's product family: BTP, SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur
Logging on to the training system
days.lab_task: Log on to the training system, find the apps for creating a purchase order, a sales order and a journal entry, and draw how one customer order flows through sales, inventory and finance.
days.deliverable: Process flow diagram and screenshots of the three apps
checks: Log on to the training client
Fiori launchpad opens with the assigned role
Find the Create Purchase Order app
Explain the difference between ECC and S/4HANA
Mentions the HANA database and simplified data model
objectives: Find your way around the system

days.topic: Navigation in SAP Fiori and SAP GUI
subtopics: Fiori app types: transactional, analytical, fact sheets
SAP GUI basics and transaction codes
days.lab_task: Personalise the launchpad with a page of daily apps, open the same customer in a Fiori fact sheet and in SAP GUI with transaction BP, save a list variant and export a report to Excel.
days.deliverable: Screenshots of the personalised page, both views and the exported file
checks: Open transaction BP in SAP GUI
Save and reload a list variant
File opens with the expected rows

days.topic: Enterprise Structure: Company Codes, Plants and Sales Areas
subtopics: Sales organisation, distribution channel and division
days.lab_task: Map the training company's enterprise structure from the system: company codes, plants, storage locations and sales areas, and draw how they are assigned to each other.
days.deliverable: Enterprise structure diagram with the system values
checks: Find the plants assigned to company code 1010
Each with organisation, channel and division
Explain why a plant belongs to one company code
objectives: Read the structure from the system

days.topic: Business Partner and Customer Master Data
subtopics: General, company code and sales area data
Changing and blocking a business partner
days.lab_task: Create a customer business partner with general, company code and sales area data, change its payment terms, block it for sales and show the block stopping a sales order.
days.deliverable: Business partner record and screenshots of the block in action
checks: Create a sales order for the blocked customer
System stops the order with a block message
Company code and sales area data present

days.topic: Material Master and Product Data
subtopics: Views: basic data, purchasing, sales, MRP, accounting
days.lab_task: Create a trading good and a finished product with all views needed to buy, store, sell and value them, and explain how the valuation class drives accounting entries.
days.deliverable: Two material records and a note on each view
checks: Create a purchase order for the trading good
Valuation class and price control shown
Leave out the sales view and try to sell the product
System reports the missing sales data

days.topic: Procure to Pay: Purchase Requisition to Purchase Order
subtopics: Sources of supply and info records
Output and sending to the supplier
days.lab_task: Create a purchase requisition, convert it to a purchase order from an info record price, route it through approval and send it to the supplier.
days.deliverable: Requisition, purchase order and approval history
checks: Convert the requisition to a purchase order
Price is taken from the info record
Create an order above the approval limit

days.topic: Procure to Pay: Goods Receipt, Invoice and Payment
subtopics: Goods receipt against a purchase order
Accounting documents created at each step
days.lab_task: Post a goods receipt with movement type 101, enter the supplier invoice, cause a price variance that blocks the invoice, release it and pay it in a payment run.
days.deliverable: Document flow with accounting documents for each step
checks: Stock increases and an accounting document is created

days.topic: Order to Cash: Sales Order to Delivery
subtopics: Outbound delivery, picking and goods issue
days.lab_task: Create a quotation, convert it to a sales order, trigger an availability check and a credit block, release the block, then deliver and post the goods issue.
days.deliverable: Sales documents and document flow
checks: Order more than the available stock
Availability check proposes a later date
Stock falls and cost of goods sold is posted
objectives: Explain pricing, availability and credit checks

days.topic: Order to Cash: Billing, Receivables and Incoming Payments
days.lab_task: Bill the delivery, check the revenue posting, post a partial incoming payment, clear the rest and process a return with a credit memo.
days.deliverable: Billing, payment and credit memo documents with the customer balance
checks: Credit memo reduces the customer balance

days.topic: Plan to Produce: MRP and Production Orders
days.lab_task: Create a sales order for a finished product, run MRP Live, convert the planned order to a production order, confirm it, receive the product and settle the order.
days.deliverable: MRP result, production order history and settlement document
checks: Planned order and purchase requisitions for components are created
Components are issued and the product is received

days.topic: Inventory Management and Warehouse Processes
days.lab_task: Move stock between storage locations, block damaged stock, run a physical inventory count with a difference and post the adjustment with its accounting impact.
days.deliverable: Material documents and inventory difference posting
checks: Post a transfer to blocked stock
Batch quantity is shown by location

days.topic: Record to Report: General Ledger and the Universal Journal
subtopics: Chart of accounts and G/L accounts
days.lab_task: Post three journal entries, reverse one, close and reopen a posting period and display the trial balance and financial statement.
days.deliverable: Journal entries, period settings and financial statement output

days.topic: Controlling: Cost Centres, Internal Orders and Profitability
subtopics: Cost elements as G/L accounts in S/4HANA
days.lab_task: Post costs to cost centres and an internal order, settle the order to a cost centre, run an assessment and view margin by product.
days.deliverable: Postings, settlement, assessment results and margin report
checks: Costs move to receiving cost centres
Revenue and cost of sales shown

days.topic: Reporting and Embedded Analytics
subtopics: Choosing between embedded analytics and a data warehouse
days.lab_task: Build a custom analytical query for sales by customer and month, add it as a tile and compare its figures with the standard sales report.
days.deliverable: Query definition, tile and comparison
checks: Drill down from month to customer
Add the query as a tile

days.topic: Users, Roles and Authorisations
subtopics: Business roles and catalogues in Fiori
days.lab_task: Give a test user a purchasing role, show a missing authorisation with SU53, fix it in the role and identify one segregation of duties conflict in a provided role set.
days.deliverable: Role changes, SU53 output and conflict note
checks: Run a blocked transaction and then SU53
Find the conflict in the role set

days.topic: Integration Between Modules
subtopics: How sales, inventory and finance connect
Tracing a transaction end to end
days.lab_task: Trace one sales order from order to cash through every document in sales, inventory, finance and controlling, and fix a planted account determination error that blocks billing.
days.deliverable: End-to-end document map and the fix
checks: Bill the order with the planted error
Error names the missing account determination

days.topic: SAP Activate and S/4HANA Project Basics
subtopics: SAP Activate phases: discover, prepare, explore, realise, deploy, run
days.lab_task: Plan a fit-to-standard workshop for procure to pay using a best-practice scope item, record three gaps and decide for each whether to change the process or extend the system.
days.deliverable: Workshop plan, gap list and decisions
checks: Correct scope item for the process
Decision follows the keep-the-core-clean rule or is justified

days.topic: Loading Data with the Migration Cockpit
days.lab_task: Load 50 customers and 100 materials with the Migration Cockpit from templates, fix the planted errors in the simulation and reconcile counts after the load.
days.deliverable: Templates, simulation log and reconciliation sheet
objectives: Load data with the Migration Cockpit

days.topic: Testing and Supporting S/4HANA
subtopics: Unit, integration and user acceptance testing
days.lab_task: Write and run test scripts for procure to pay and order to cash, log two defects with clear steps and evidence, and answer five common user support questions.
days.deliverable: Test scripts, results, defects and support answers
checks: Every step has a result and evidence
Another participant can reproduce it from the description
At least four correct with the fix

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: End-to-End Processes for a Model Company
subtopics: Procure to pay and order to cash
days.lab_task: Run a month for a model company: create master data, buy materials, produce and sell goods, collect payment, post a period-end accrual and present financial and margin reports with the document trail.
days.deliverable: Document trail, reports and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Show the document trail for one sale
Every document from order to payment is linked
Matches revenue less cost of sales
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one business month

intermediate.summary: For consultants and IT staff who use S/4HANA. Covers the architecture and data model, configuration in the IMG, the simplification list, migration approaches and tools, custom code adaptation, Fiori and embedded analytics, integration, extensibility, security and running S/4HANA projects.
prerequisites: Can run the main business processes in S/4HANA
Knows the enterprise structure and master data
Has been part of an SAP project or support team
outcomes: Explain S/4HANA architecture and the simplified data model
Configure core settings and Fiori content
Plan greenfield, brownfield and selective migrations
Integrate and extend S/4HANA while keeping the core clean

days.topic: S/4HANA Architecture and the Simplified Data Model
subtopics: SAP HANA in-memory and columnar storage
tools: SAP HANA Studio or HANA Cockpit
days.lab_task: Compare reading finance data from ACDOCA with the old table structure using compatibility views, and trace a transport from development to quality.
days.deliverable: Data model comparison and transport log
checks: All line items from all ledgers are shown
Read BSEG-style data through a compatibility view

days.topic: Configuration in the IMG and Customising Settings
subtopics: Central Business Configuration in Public Cloud
days.lab_task: Configure a new purchasing document type and a number range in the IMG, record it in a transport, compare the setting between two clients and document it.
days.deliverable: Configuration, transport and documentation
checks: Create a purchase order with the new type
Compare the setting in two clients
Difference is shown before import and gone after
Another consultant could repeat the setting

days.topic: The Simplification List and Functional Changes from ECC
subtopics: Business partner instead of customer and vendor masters
MRP Live and planned independent requirements
Finding relevant items with Readiness Check
days.lab_task: Analyse a provided ECC system's Readiness Check results, list the ten simplification items with the most impact and plan the business and technical actions for each.
days.deliverable: Impact analysis and action plan
checks: Each has impact and an action

days.topic: Migration Approaches: Greenfield, Brownfield and Selective
days.lab_task: For three provided company cases, recommend greenfield, brownfield or selective transition with reasons, risks and a high-level plan, and defend one recommendation.
days.deliverable: Three recommendations with plans
checks: Data, process and timeline risks covered
Defend one choice in five minutes

days.topic: System Conversion: Readiness Check, SUM and DMO
days.lab_task: Plan a conversion for a provided ECC system: interpret the Readiness Check, list prerequisites, describe the SUM DMO run and plan finance migration steps and downtime.
days.deliverable: Conversion plan with downtime estimate
checks: Includes Unicode, add-on compatibility and simplification items
Based on data volume and stated assumptions

days.topic: Data Migration with the Migration Cockpit at Project Scale
days.lab_task: Run two mock loads of customers, suppliers, materials and open items in the right order with value mappings, measure quality and reconcile balances.
days.deliverable: Load plan, mapping rules, mock load reports and reconciliation

days.topic: Custom Code Adaptation and the ABAP Test Cockpit
subtopics: Usage analysis to remove unused code
ABAP Test Cockpit checks for S/4HANA
Common fixes: data model, field length, removed functions
Quick fixes in ABAP Development Tools
days.lab_task: Run S/4HANA readiness checks on a set of custom programs, remove unused code based on usage data, fix three findings with quick fixes and plan the rest.
days.deliverable: Check results, fixes and remediation plan

days.topic: Fiori Configuration: Launchpad Content, Spaces and Roles
subtopics: Troubleshooting tiles that do not open
days.lab_task: Find three apps in the Fiori apps library, activate their services, build a space and page for a purchasing role and fix a tile that does not open.
days.deliverable: Role content, activation steps and troubleshooting notes
checks: Open the broken tile after the fix
Explain the cause of the broken tile
Missing service or target mapping identified

days.topic: Embedded Analytics with CDS Views
subtopics: Custom CDS views with key user tools
When to move to a data warehouse
days.lab_task: Create a custom CDS view for open purchase orders by supplier, build an analytical query and KPI tile on it and check that users only see their own plants.
days.deliverable: CDS view, query, KPI tile and authorisation test
checks: Log on as a user for one plant
Only that plant's orders are shown
Compare totals with the standard report

days.topic: Output Management and Forms
days.lab_task: Configure email output of purchase orders to suppliers with a customised form template and test it with two suppliers that have different output rules.
days.deliverable: Output configuration, form and test emails
checks: Save a purchase order for supplier A
Email with the form is sent
Save one for supplier B with print output
New logo appears in the output

days.topic: Integration with External Systems: IDocs, APIs and Events
subtopics: Event-driven integration with SAP Event Mesh
days.lab_task: Read and create sales orders through the OData API with Postman using a communication arrangement, subscribe to a business partner change event and monitor a failed call.
days.deliverable: API calls, event subscription and monitoring screenshots
checks: Create a sales order through the API
Send a call with a missing field
Error is visible in monitoring with the reason
objectives: Integrate S/4HANA with APIs and events

days.topic: Extensibility: Key User, Developer and Side-by-Side
subtopics: Key user extensibility: custom fields and logic
days.lab_task: Add a custom field to the sales order with key user tools, add validation logic, and design a side-by-side BTP extension for a complex approval, choosing each option with reasons.
days.deliverable: Custom field, logic, extension design and decision note
checks: Create a sales order with the custom field
Field is saved and shown in the app
Option chosen per clean core rules

days.topic: Business Process Monitoring and Process Mining
tools: SAP Signavio Process Intelligence or process mining tool
days.lab_task: Load procure-to-pay event data into a process mining tool, find the three biggest delays and non-conformant paths and propose fixes with expected gains.
days.deliverable: Process map, findings and proposals
checks: Process map shows all main steps

days.topic: Security, GRC and Audit in S/4HANA
days.lab_task: Design roles for accounts payable that avoid a segregation of duties conflict, run a risk analysis, grant firefighter access with logging and review the audit log.
days.deliverable: Role design, risk analysis results and audit log review
checks: No conflicts in the new roles
Find an unusual logon in the audit log

days.topic: Testing and Test Automation for S/4HANA
subtopics: Test strategy for implementations and upgrades
Test automation tool for S/4HANA Cloud
days.lab_task: Build a regression pack for order to cash, automate two scripts, run them after a configuration change and report the results.
days.deliverable: Regression pack, automated scripts and test report
checks: Run after the planted breaking change
One script fails at the right step

days.topic: S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and Fit-to-Standard Delivery
tools: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition trial
days.lab_task: Run a fit-to-standard session for order to cash in a Public Cloud system, record gaps, solve them with configuration or key user extensibility and list what is not possible.
days.deliverable: Session record, gap solutions and limits list
checks: Each gap has a solution or is marked not possible
Configure one change in Central Business Configuration

days.topic: Period-End Closing Across Modules
subtopics: Closing tasks in logistics and finance
Goods receipt and invoice receipt clearing
days.lab_task: Run a month-end close in the training system: open the next period, clear GR/IR, post accruals, run depreciation, settle orders, revalue foreign currency items and track every task in a closing task list.
days.deliverable: Closing task list with results and the resulting financial statement
checks: Depreciation is posted to the right accounts
Revalue an open foreign currency invoice
Unrealised gain or loss is posted
Every task is completed with its result

days.topic: Master Data Governance and Data Quality
days.lab_task: Set up a change request process for supplier creation with approval and a duplicate check, apply three data quality rules and measure the quality of the existing supplier data.
days.deliverable: Process set-up, rule results and data quality report
checks: Create a supplier that duplicates an existing one
Approver must approve before the supplier is active
Failing records listed with the rule broken

days.topic: Cutover, Go-Live and Hypercare
tools: SAP Solution Manager or Cloud ALM
days.lab_task: Write a cutover plan with timings for a weekend go-live, run a rehearsal against the plan, set go or no-go criteria and plan two weeks of hypercare.
days.deliverable: Cutover plan, rehearsal results and hypercare plan
checks: Actual times recorded against the plan
Covers triage, staffing and exit criteria

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: S/4HANA Implementation Plan and Prototype
days.lab_task: Produce an implementation plan for a provided company with an approach recommendation, a configured prototype of two processes, a data migration mock load, an integration and extension design, test and cutover plans, then present it.
days.deliverable: Plan, prototype, mock load report and a 15-minute steering committee presentation
checks: Both run end to end in the system
Approach and risks defended with evidence
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one plan
Prove the plan with a prototype

advanced.summary: For senior consultants, architects and programme leads. Covers large conversion programmes, clean core architecture, multi-system landscapes, central finance, performance and data volume management, BTP and AI on top of S/4HANA, Business Data Cloud, security at scale, upgrades and programme governance.
prerequisites: Has worked on at least one S/4HANA implementation or conversion
Leads a workstream or architecture area
outcomes: Lead large conversion and transformation programmes
Design finance, data and AI architectures around S/4HANA
Govern performance, security and upgrades at scale

days.topic: Enterprise Architecture for S/4HANA Landscapes
subtopics: One global instance versus regional instances
BTP as the extension and integration platform
days.lab_task: Design the target landscape for a multinational with five regions, choose single or regional instances, define the integration and extension architecture and record the main decisions.
days.deliverable: Target architecture, decision records and non-functional requirements
checks: Justified with business and technical drivers
Every system interface has a pattern
Availability, performance and security targets stated

days.topic: Clean Core Strategy and Governance
subtopics: The clean core dimensions: processes, extensions, data, integration, operations
ABAP Cloud and the three-tier extensibility model
days.lab_task: Assess a provided system against the clean core dimensions, score it, classify its 40 largest extensions by tier and write a two-year roadmap to a cleaner core.
days.deliverable: Clean core assessment, extension classification and roadmap
checks: Each assigned a tier with a reason
Steps reduce upgrade effort with estimates

days.topic: Large Conversion Programmes: Planning and Execution
days.lab_task: Plan a five-country conversion programme with waves, downtime-optimised options, three mock conversions with timing targets and a dual maintenance strategy.
days.deliverable: Programme plan, mock conversion plan and dual maintenance approach
checks: Each mock reduces downtime with stated actions

days.topic: Central Finance and Finance Transformation
days.lab_task: Design a Central Finance solution for three source ERPs, define mapping for accounts and cost centres, handle a replication error and plan the move to central payments.
days.deliverable: Solution design, mapping rules and error handling procedure
checks: Map a source account to the central chart

days.topic: Performance Engineering on SAP HANA
days.lab_task: Find the three most expensive statements in a provided workload, analyse them with the plan visualiser and SQL trace, fix them and measure the gain.
days.deliverable: Analysis, fixes and before and after measurements
checks: Size memory for three years of growth

days.topic: Data Volume Management and Archiving
days.lab_task: Analyse data volume in a provided system, design an archiving plan for the top five objects with residence times and legal holds, and archive one object in the training system.
days.deliverable: Volume analysis, archiving plan and archive run log
checks: Run an archive for one object

days.topic: Advanced Integration Architecture with SAP Integration Suite
subtopics: Event Mesh and Advanced Event Mesh
days.lab_task: Build an iFlow that sends S/4HANA sales orders to a third-party logistics provider, expose a stock API through API Management with a rate limit and plan a PI/PO migration wave.
days.deliverable: iFlow, API proxy and migration plan
checks: Message reaches the logistics provider in their format
Interfaces grouped by pattern and effort

days.topic: Side-by-Side Extensions on SAP BTP
days.lab_task: Build a CAP extension that reads S/4HANA purchase orders through a destination, adds an approval workflow in SAP Build and reacts to an S/4HANA event.
days.deliverable: CAP application, workflow and event handling demo
checks: Open the extension as a business user
User's own purchase orders appear through principal propagation
Change a purchase order in S/4HANA

days.topic: Business AI: Joule and AI Scenarios in S/4HANA
subtopics: Embedded AI scenarios in finance and supply chain
SAP AI Core and generative AI hub
days.lab_task: Evaluate three embedded AI scenarios for a provided company, try Joule on common tasks and design one custom generative AI scenario on the generative AI hub with grounding and controls.
days.deliverable: Scenario evaluation, Joule test results and custom scenario design
checks: Benefits and risks estimated for each

days.topic: SAP Business Data Cloud and Analytics Architecture
subtopics: Analytics options: embedded, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud
days.lab_task: Design an analytics architecture combining S/4HANA and non-SAP sales data, model it in Datasphere and build an Analytics Cloud story, comparing federation and replication.
days.deliverable: Architecture, Datasphere model, story and comparison
checks: Compare federation and replication query times

days.topic: Advanced Finance: Universal Journal Extensions and Group Reporting
days.lab_task: Configure an extension ledger for management adjustments, run an intercompany reconciliation and a consolidation in Group Reporting and plan a faster month-end close.
days.deliverable: Configuration, reconciliation results, consolidation output and close plan

days.topic: Advanced Supply Chain: EWM, TM and IBP Integration
days.lab_task: Design a supply chain solution that uses embedded EWM and TM, product allocation in advanced ATP and IBP for planning, and run an advanced ATP check in the training system.
days.deliverable: Supply chain design and ATP test results
checks: Run an order above the allocation
Advanced ATP confirms only the allocated quantity

days.topic: Security Architecture and Compliance at Scale
subtopics: Identity architecture with SAP Cloud Identity Services
GRC Access Control and process control
Security monitoring with Enterprise Threat Detection
days.lab_task: Design identity and access for a multi-system SAP landscape with single sign-on and MFA, set up a threat detection pattern for privilege escalation and plan monthly security patching.
days.deliverable: Identity design, detection pattern and patching plan
checks: Log on with SSO and MFA
Access works across S/4HANA and BTP

days.topic: Upgrades, Feature Packs and Continuous Innovation
subtopics: Release strategy for Private and Public Cloud
days.lab_task: Plan an upgrade to the next S/4HANA release with impact analysis, custom code checks, automated regression and a feature adoption backlog, and estimate the effort.
days.deliverable: Upgrade plan, impact analysis and adoption backlog

days.topic: Application Lifecycle Management with SAP Cloud ALM
days.lab_task: Set up Cloud ALM for a project with requirements, tasks and test cases, connect monitoring for an interface and a business process and create alerts.
days.deliverable: Cloud ALM project, monitoring setup and alerts
checks: Link a requirement to a test case

days.topic: Mergers, Divestitures and Landscape Transformation
days.lab_task: Plan the carve-out of one company code into a new system for a buyer, define data separation rules, a testing approach and a timeline that meets the legal close date.
days.deliverable: Carve-out plan, data rules and timeline
checks: Meets the close date with buffers

days.topic: RISE with SAP and Cloud Operating Models
subtopics: Private Cloud responsibilities: SAP, hyperscaler and customer
Network connectivity to the SAP data centre
Backups, disaster recovery and maintenance windows
days.lab_task: Compare running a provided S/4HANA landscape on-premise, on a hyperscaler and under RISE, with a responsibility matrix, network design and five-year cost, and recommend one.
days.deliverable: Responsibility matrix, network design, cost comparison and recommendation
checks: Every task has an owner for each option
All three options costed with assumptions
Supported by cost, risk and responsibilities

days.topic: Programme Governance, Business Case and Value Realisation
days.lab_task: Build a business case with value drivers and KPIs for a provided company, set up the governance structure and write the first steering committee report with risks and decisions.
days.deliverable: Business case, governance chart and steering report
checks: Top risks have owners and actions

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production S/4HANA Systems
subtopics: Root cause analysis and SAP notes
days.lab_task: Resolve four injected problems (a short dump, a failed update, a stuck lock and a failed background job), find root causes and the matching SAP notes and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident records, fixes and runbooks
checks: Write a runbook for failed jobs

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: S/4HANA Transformation Blueprint
subtopics: Finance, supply chain and analytics design
days.lab_task: Produce a transformation blueprint for a multinational with target architecture, clean core plan, programme waves, finance and supply chain design, integration and AI scenarios, security and operations, then present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Blueprint document, decision records, programme plan and a 20-minute board presentation
checks: Waves, downtime and risks are realistic
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one blueprint
